title: Echocardiography Protocol for Mice
author: Anil Singapuri
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.yiafuae

steps.title: Prepare the animal
steps.instruction: Prepare the mouse for imaging by shaving the chest and positioning it supine on a surgical table covered with a towel warmed to 37°C.

steps.title: Restrain the mouse
steps.instruction: Restrain the mouse in a 50 ml conical tube that has an opening for the nose and chest.

steps.title: Perform echocardiography imaging
steps.instruction: Perform M-mode and two-dimensional measurements to assess systolic function over a duration of 2-5 minutes.

steps.title: Analyze cardiac cycles
steps.instruction: Select an average of six cardiac cycles from at least two separate scans performed in a random-blind fashion, using the papillary muscles as a point of reference.

steps.title: Define cardiac dimensions
steps.instruction: Identify the end diastole and end systole of the heart.

substeps.instruction: Define end diastole as the maximal left ventricular (LV) diastolic dimension.
Define end systole as the peak of posterior wall motion.

steps.title: Calculate Fractional Shortening (FS)
steps.instruction: Calculate the Fractional Shortening (FS) as a surrogate of systolic function using the LV dimensions.

substeps.instruction: Apply the formula: FS = ((EDD − ESD) / EDD) × 100%, where EDD is the LV end diastolic dimension and ESD is the LV end systolic dimension.
